admission.justification: The obligation is one member of the reading-place family's joint guarantee; no other admission criterion is claimed.

applicability: An overview or a card opened in the Knowledge reader.
conditions: Path line, title, one facts line, the text, invariants, families, decisions and other records, references last.
No empty section is drawn and a sentence already standing in the text is not repeated in the references.
exclusions: The order and content of the overview files themselves (MIK-R80).
A record's own page, which rule 12 owns.
statement: A path document presents breadcrumbs, its own title, facts, uninterrupted prose, invariants, families, other records and references, without empty sections.
